subtasks.task_text: Describe the initial setup needed for a vertical garden.
subtasks.text: Measure and mark the spots for attaching small pots on a reclaimed wood plank.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the initial setup needed for a vertical garden.
subtasks.text: Drill holes at the marked spots for securing the pots.

subtasks.task_text: Detail the installation of the small pots.
subtasks.text: Screw small pots into the drilled holes to ensure they are secure.

subtasks.task_text: Detail the installation of the small pots.
subtasks.text: Attach hooks or brackets to the top of the plank for hanging the garden.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the final steps to complete the vertical garden.
subtasks.text: Fill the pots with soil and plant your chosen herbs.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the final steps to complete the vertical garden.
subtasks.text: Water the plants and place the garden in a sunny location.
